content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On Ir Swap, the Counterparty textbox shows a visible error right after it gains focus (error events 61:a65 and 98:a104), and in both sessions the user then opens Static Data > Counterparty from the top menu (clicks 92 and 140), reaches counterparty:screen, and returns to Ir Swap after a save-success action (app:23:success, app:17:success). This suggests the Counterparty field needs a value that the user has to look up or create on the Counterparty screen, but the error gives no in-place path to it.", "fix": "Fix: On the Ir Swap screen, in the Counterparty textbox, render the validation message inline when the error appears and add a link beside it that opens the Counterparty list (or a picker/search) so the user can select a valid counterparty without navigating to Static Data > Counterparty and back.", "cited_event_ids": ["61:a65", "98:a104", "92", "140", "app:21", "app:15", "app:23:success", "app:17:success", "app:23", "app:17"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text of the error message is not in the events, so the required counterparty rule is inferred, not confirmed.", "The reason for each detour to Static Data > Counterparty is not stated in the events; the link between the error and the detour is a timing pattern only.", "Whether the tab click before each return (ids 124, 175, 209) performs a save or a counterparty check is not visible.", "Coverage gaps are empty, but 140 pointer samples were dropped per session, so exact cursor paths between the error and the detour are unknown.", "Only 2 of the 3 affected sessions' windows are provided in the evidence; the third session's behaviour is taken from the insight facts only.", "The insight's 'No abandonment observed' outcome is taken as given; no completion status is visible in the windows beyond the app_action success events."]}
